prerequisites: Existing uv and Git; source-specific compiler/system libraries and backend prerequisites from nstack show P374. This recipe selects CPU/basic package only; it installs no weights, provider extras, device driver, daemon or global tool. Build/submodule incompatibility fails closed.
lock_resolution: Fetch and check out only this exact commit in a private owned build prefix. Resolve explicit source build-system requirements to a hash lock, build one wheel without build isolation, verify its distribution metadata, resolve runtime dependencies to a second hash lock, sync with required hashes. Retain source/wheel/interpreter/uv identity and all environment file hashes. Repeat commissioning verifies the existing lock without resolving upgrades.
invoke: From a bounded project: nstack run P374 server -- /absolute/project/script.py [arguments]. Use only the registered package API, actual task inputs and current project permissions.
check: nstack check P374 server (actual import and distribution identity only). Then execute the distinct output, negative control and independent comparison from the component acceptance checks; import success is not domain acceptance.
deactivate: Each script exits normally; stop only a task-owned service started by that script after reconciling effects. nstack remove-runtime P374 server quarantines the exact owned environment and lock into private recovery. No global registration is created.
task_prerequisites: Owned Docker/Kubernetes backend and separately pinned runtime image
Kubernetes pause requires controller, single replica, registry and push/pull credentials; durable data store for must-survive output
task_acceptance: Unrun: deny unauthorized egress, write checksum, force pod loss before and after successful snapshot, restore and prove which data/processes survived.
service_activation: Server: use the built opensandbox-server init-config TASK_CONFIG --example docker, inspect its exact schema and bind loopback/explicit port plus the already-owned Docker backend. Start opensandbox-server --config TASK_CONFIG only for the named task. SDK: run a project script using Sandbox.create with an explicit image digest, execute a harmless command, export its result, test expiry/reconnect and destroy that same sandbox. Persist must-survive output outside ephemeral containers. No backend/account/credential is provisioned by commissioning.
